purpose: Recover the clock-faulted Gate-6 randomized-block evidence without selectively rerunning only the failed original-M-TARE case.

approval.scope: One immutable 21-case system-recovery execution: all nine tunnel_env23 cases plus original schedule indices 77 through 89; compose only 69 sealed unaffected PASS cases from the predecessor into a complete 90-case analysis.
approval.confirmation_reference: The user explicitly delegated all optimal in-scope decisions and asked not to be prompted for repeated approvals.

trajectory_and_sampling.recovery_selection: The complete tunnel_env23 block union original schedule indices 77..89, retaining original schedule order.
trajectory_and_sampling.independent_sampling_units: Ten world-by-environment-seed blocks; execution repeats and checkpoint seeds are not independent worlds.
trajectory_and_sampling.temporal_sampling: Every required ROS message during exactly 600 simulated seconds after the first waypoint.
trajectory_and_sampling.spatial_sampling: Finite registered scans accumulated in fixed 0.5 m voxels; no frame, trajectory or waypoint deletion.

methods.main: Unchanged readiness-qualified V9 causal structural-topology global planner.
methods.baseline: Unchanged original M-TARE global planner and frozen planner seed.
methods.necessary_fallback_or_upper_bound: Unchanged layered complete-development-map diagnostic oracle; never a performance upper bound.

model_and_teacher.checkpoint_selection: The same three checkpoints frozen before the predecessor run; no selection or training.
model_and_teacher.teacher: No teacher or complete map enters original M-TARE or V9; only the explicit oracle reads the development complete map.

failure_diagnosis.host_evidence: systemd-resolved recorded 'Clock change detected' at 2026-08-23 12:57:13 +08:00 while the case was active.
failure_diagnosis.scientific_effect: The simulator and bag reached the full interval, but the frozen finite-value contract correctly failed. No invalid sample is deleted or repaired and the predecessor remains FAILED.

metrics_and_statistics.primary: Unchanged 0.5 m unique-voxel coverage-time AUC over 600 seconds.
metrics_and_statistics.analysis: Compose 69 sealed unaffected predecessor cases with all 21 recovery cases, verify exact 90-case identity and ten complete blocks, then apply the unchanged sign-flip, 10,000-sample bootstrap and Holm analysis.
metrics_and_statistics.effect_policy: The predecessor remains formal FAIL. V3R PASS certifies a transparent system-recovery composition, not retroactive success of V3.

forbidden: reuse of failed case 077 partial assets
leakage_and_failure_policy.stop: Any source seal, schedule, image, checkpoint, topic, timing, finite-value, planner, archive, disk or composition failure seals V3R FAIL without retry.

evidence.per_case: Twenty-one new complete case contracts, logs, verified lossless bags, metrics and method-specific graph evidence.
evidence.source: Exact predecessor FAILED state/seal, 69 unaffected source cases verified against the seal, and an explicit record that eight prior affected-block results are excluded.
evidence.aggregate: 21-case recovery schedule, 90-case source map, ten-block statistics, RUN_STATE and SHA-256 seal.
evidence.expected_pass_counts: 21/21 recovery cases, 69 sealed source cases, 90 unique composed cases, 10 blocks, 30 cases per family, zero C09/C10/training/optimizer activity.

estimated_cost.compute: Serial CPU/Gazebo/ROS, 12,600 simulated seconds, no GPU; host zstd-10 after every case; 150 GiB free-space floor.
